description: Look up the full public catalog record for a standalone mod or Foundation Kit after finding its ID with search_catalog. Returns its price, published features and limits where supplied, and pricing policy. Unknown and hidden IDs return the same error. Use get_setup_overview for setup steps or get_compatibility_guidance to compare published mod support with your stack.

id.description: Lowercase product ID from search_catalog, such as "funnel" or "foundation-kit" when listed.

name: get_mod_details
title: Read mod details
